title: Skip import-untyped mypy errors without LLM
problem: import-untyped requires stub packages — 100% rejection rate across 4 repos. Pipeline wasted LLM cycles and spuriously counted them as rejected.
change_summary: Added _UNFIXABLE_MYPY_CODES frozenset at module level; added check after is_unfixable() to return State.NEXT_ERROR immediately for import-untyped errors

title: Add _vendor to SKIP_DIRS
problem: Vendor code (e.g. tablib/_vendor/dbfpy) was being analyzed and targeted for fixes. W504 errors in vendor code cannot be safely fixed and waste pipeline cycles.
change_summary: Added _vendor to SKIP_DIRS frozenset so vendor directories are excluded from flake8 and AST analysis.

title: Add W391 rule-based handler
problem: W391 (blank line at end of file) went to LLM pipeline unnecessarily. Trivial deterministic fix.
change_summary: Added W391 to Python dispatch and _py_blank_line_at_eof handler: delete last line if blank.

title: W503 max_line_length uses project config instead of hardcoded 79
problem: W503 rule used _MAX_LEN=79. Projects with ruff (line-length=88) had W503 go to NR because result lines were 80-88 chars. Confirmed in typer (multiple W503 in NR).
change_summary: Added max_line_length param to try_fix(); W503 handler reads self._max_line_length; call site in generate_patch_stage detects project line-length via _detect_project_line_length(work_dir).

finding: F4 — sandbox paths (webbles_isolated_*/.webles_sandbox) appearing in NR queue as phantom errors
root_cause: _prepare_environment() copytree did not exclude .webles_sandbox; semgrep reported absolute paths inside temp copy
fix: analyze_stage.py: normalize absolute semgrep paths to relative (relative_to work_dir); filter residual sandbox markers
impact: boltons NR: 6->2 (-4 phantom); requests NR: 8->4 (-4 phantom), accepted: 4->7 (+3)

root_cause: E127 (over-indented) and E128 (under-indented) continuation lines went to LLM despite having a deterministic fix. LLM was inconsistent on these.
fix: rule_based_fixer.py: added E127/E128 handlers to dispatch
_py_e127_e128_visual_indent(): tokenize-based bracket stack scan finds visual indent column; adjusts line indent
algorithm: tokenize.generate_tokens builds bracket stack before problem line; last unmatched bracket gives anchor; first real token after bracket on same line = visual_col; replace current line indent with visual_col spaces
coverage: boltons: 26/26 E127/E128 fixable (100%); handles strings-with-brackets correctly via tokenize
